title: Storefront types by business category (content/storefronts.json). Unnamed: iconography only.
description: Maps a NAICS code (the pipeline's storefront anchors carry the business registry's self-reported code) to a storefront kit: the glazed shopfront bay, an awning shape by category, an empty sign slot with an icon-only sign shape, and street props (house kit K5). The longest matching prefix wins (storefrontFor in src/content/storefronts.ts). Signs carry no text and no names: the sign slot is reserved, signText stays null.

noStorefrontPrefixes.description: Codes that never get a kit even though a broader prefix matches (non-store retail, caterers). Mirrors the pipeline's exclusions.

naicsNote.description: Which NAICS vintage each prefix comes from, and why it is here.

categories.description: The pipeline's coarse category values (pipeline/lib/storefronts.ts categoryOf) this kit serves; tests/content/storefronts.test.ts checks every committed anchor's kit lists its category.

signSlot.description: The empty panel reserved for a future sign, in metres, relative to the shopfront.

shopfront.description: The instanced glazed bay drawn at each anchor (house kit K5: a 5 m bay, 3.5 to 4.5 m tall).

glazing.description: Share of the bay that is glass.

stallRiserM.description: Solid stall riser under the window.

frames.description: Mullion, door and stall-riser colours; one is picked per anchor.

awning.description: The awning shape by category; a colour is picked per anchor. Shape none has depth 0 and no colours.

stripe.description: The second colour of a striped awning.

nightGlow.description: The sign or a prop is lit after dark.

signText.description: Reserved for later. Must be null for now: storefronts are unnamed.

contentHash.description: FNV-1a over the file's player-facing text joined by newlines (src/content/barks.ts contentHash).

reviewedBy.description: Reviewing agent sessions and, for sampled drops, the sample ids.

provenance.description: A copy of schemas/provenance.schema.json, inlined because tests/schemas/schemas.test.ts compiles this schema on its own; tests/content/provenance.test.ts keeps the copy equal.

signShape.description: neonPanel: a glowing tube panel in the window, shaped like a beer glass; fasciaBand: a flat blank band above the door; cupBlade: a projecting blade sign shaped like a coffee cup; breadBlade: a projecting loaf-shaped blade; barberPole: the striped spinning pole is the sign; scissorsBlade: a projecting scissors-and-comb blade; projectingCross: a lit cross on a bracket; hangerBlade: a projecting coat-hanger blade; awningValance: the sign is the awning's front flap.; takeoutBoxBlade: a projecting takeout-box blade; bottleBlade: a projecting bottle blade; polishBlade: a projecting nail-polish-bottle blade; shirtBlade: a projecting shirt blade; keyBlade: a projecting key-shaped blade; plugBlade: a projecting plug blade; lampBlade: a projecting lamp blade; bookBlade: a projecting open-book blade; wheelBlade: a projecting wheel blade; dropPanel: a pole sign with a drop icon over a blank price board.

prop.description: Street-level dressing the renderer places at the shopfront. Assets build one generic model per prop.

awningShape.description: none: no awning; slope: a sloped fabric awning; striped: a sloped awning in two colours; scalloped: a sloped awning with a scalloped valance; box: a boxed awning with closed sides; quarterRound: a curved dome awning; flatCanopy: a flat metal canopy on tie rods; canopy: a free-standing canopy over a forecourt (fuel).
